name: Omarchy Buds
author: Abhay Kshatriya
description: Battery, noise control and settings for Bluetooth earbuds in the Omarchy bar, powered by BudsLink's device support (AirPods, Galaxy Buds, Sony, Nothing, Pixel Buds, Redmi, Realme/Oppo/OnePlus, Bose, Sennheiser, Soundcore and more).

barWidget.description: Battery and noise control for connected earbuds, with a dropdown when several are connected.

schema.label: Show battery in the bar
schema.description: Show the emptier earbud's battery next to the icon.

schema.label: Hide when no earbuds are connected
Low battery level (%)
schema.description: The icon turns urgent at or below this level.

schema.label: Hidden features
schema.description: Feature switches to leave out of the panel, for every device. They stay as they are on the earbuds; the panel just doesn't offer them.

options.label: In-ear detection
options.description: Pause when an earbud comes out

options.label: Dual connection
options.description: Connect to two devices at once
